activities.description: Conversations with AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
activities.icon_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" > <path d="M12 8V4H8" /> <rect width="16" height="12" x="4" y="8" rx="2" /> <path d="M2 14h2" /> <path d="M20 14h2" /> <path d="M15 13v2" /> <path d="M9 13v2" /> </svg>

Detect via: AI assistant interfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), imported AI conversation transcripts, prompt-response patterns. Do not confuse with messaging — AI conversation involves a human interacting with an AI model, not person-to-person chat.
